metadata.title: A reproducible GeoAI framework for explainable spatiotemporal analysis of national missing-person registers: multi-algorithm clustering and multilevel validation (Peru, 2019-2025): code and Colab notebook
metadata.description:
Code and Colab notebook for the paper A reproducible GeoAI framework for explainable spatiotemporal analysis of national missing-person registers: multi-algorithm clustering and multilevel validation (Peru, 2019-2025), submitted to Information Sciences (Elsevier).

The pipeline reads the open reports of Peru's National Registry of Information on Missing Persons (RENIPED, 2019–2025) and official population denominators, builds the 26-territory by 84-month panel, and runs the rate comparison, multi-algorithm clustering, spatial association and multilevel validation, including the specification multiverse. The analysis plan (config/analysis_plan.json) is fingerprinted and checked at the start of every run. Every table and figure in the paper is written by the pipeline.

Run end to end with the included Colab notebook (notebooks/experiments.ipynb) or locally with python run_all.py; dependencies are listed in requirements-experiments.txt. Internal code: C26-2026.
